subject.title: fix(json-parse): exclude code-context tails from Windows-path heuristic (#93139)

question: Should malformed JSON containing a lowercase Windows drive letter immediately after a recognized block keyword favor code-header newline preservation, as this PR does, or preserve the prior path-biased recovery behavior?
rationale: Both forms have the same suffix shape, so code alone cannot preserve both outcomes. The branch documents the trade-off and proves uppercase-path compatibility, but a maintainer must set the intended compatibility policy for lowercase drive letters.

options.title: Accept code-biased lowercase candidates
options.body: Merge the proposed rule, treating whitespace-separated lowercase candidates after recognized block keywords as code while retaining the tested uppercase and punctuation-delimited path behavior.

options.title: Preserve path-biased recovery
options.body: Pause this PR and choose a different heuristic if supporting lowercase drive-letter paths in this ambiguous malformed-JSON position is more important than the reported code-header repair.

recommendation.title: Accept code-biased lowercase candidates
recommendation.body: Merge the proposed rule, treating whitespace-separated lowercase candidates after recognized block keywords as code while retaining the tested uppercase and punctuation-delimited path behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: A current-main history lookup is needed to identify the specific owner of the AI JSON-repair path; the supplied context does not establish one safely.
